recognize_zh: 頭顱正位與側位 X 光片上整個顱穹窿布滿大量小而邊界清楚、無硬化邊緣的圓形透亮溶骨病灶（punched-out lesions，俗稱 raindrop / pepper-pot skull），是多發性骨髓瘤的典型影像。
features: Plain radiographs of the skull, anteroposterior and lateral views (same pair shown twice)
Innumerable small, round, well-defined radiolucent lesions throughout the calvarium
Lesions lack a sclerotic rim or periosteal reaction ('punched-out' appearance)
Diffuse distribution involving frontal, parietal and occipital bones; no single dominant expansile mass evident
describe_en: Anteroposterior and lateral plain radiographs of the skull demonstrate innumerable small, well-circumscribed, round lytic lesions diffusely involving the calvarium, without sclerotic margins or periosteal reaction. No large expansile lesion is identified at this resolution. This punched-out ('raindrop') pattern is characteristic of plasma cell myeloma, although correlation with serum/urine protein studies and bone marrow examination is required. Findings are consistent with multiple myeloma bone disease.

ddx.vs: Metastases are usually fewer, more variable in size with irregular margins, and the primary tumor or cytokeratin-positive marrow disease identifies them.
Shows fine granular mottled demineralization rather than discrete punched-out lesions, with elevated PTH and calcium.
Usually fewer, larger lesions with bevelled edges ('hole-within-a-hole') in younger patients, with CD1a/langerin-positive cells on biopsy.
